toegepas.voor: 'n geboë spieël waardeur jy self kyk
toegepas.na: 'n geboë spieël. Jy kyk self daardeur
toegepas.rede_vinder: The relative clause attaches to the nearest noun, so it says you look through the mirror; a separate sentence makes 'daardeur' refer to the telescope.
toegepas.fout: The relative clause 'waardeur jy self kyk' attaches to the nearest noun, so the sentence says you look through the curved mirror itself.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Splitting the sentence lets 'daardeur' point back to the telescope the paragraph is about, with the same meaning, nothing added, and the protected Sun rule untouched.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Avoids 'baie groot ... baie seshoekige' twice in one sentence without changing the meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'baie groot spieel ... baie seshoekige stukke' repeats 'baie' twice in one sentence, and 'baie seshoekige' can briefly read as 'very hexagonal'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'talle' keeps the meaning 'many' exactly, removes the repetition, and matches the 'talle klein antennas' fix already kept in the SKA paragraph.

toegepas.blok: Wiele en asse laat 'n rover rol
toegepas.rede_vinder: An Afrikaans compound with no vowel clash is written as one word under the AWS.
toegepas.fout: 'model-rover' carries a hyphen the AWS does not call for in a compound with no vowel clash (compare 'modelmotor', and the lesson's own 'Marsrover').
toegepas.rede_keurder: A plain spelling fix that changes nothing else; the protected 'Robot-rovers' sentence is not touched.

toegepas.voor: neem minute om aan te kom
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Neem minute om aan te kom' calques 'takes minutes to arrive'; 'is minute lank onderweg' is the natural Afrikaans with the same meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'n Boodskap ... neem minute om aan te kom' copies the English 'takes minutes to arrive' with a message as the subject of 'neem'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'is minute lank onderweg' is the natural Afrikaans way to say it, keeps the same unstated number of minutes, and still leads into the next sentence's 'Daarom'.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Rekenaars maak van die radiogolwe inligting en beelde.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Rekenaars verander die radiogolwe in inligting en beelde.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The fronted 'van die radiogolwe' makes the sentence awkward; 'verander ... in' states the same process plainly.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'maak van die radiogolwe inligting en beelde' is natural Afrikaans, so the proposal is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Die Maanrover: mense ry op die Maan
laat_vaar_vorige.na: meer verken as wat hulle te voet kon
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The elliptical comparison 'as te voet' is loose; completing it makes the comparison clear.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The short comparison 'as te voet' is natural Afrikaans, and completing it only makes the sentence longer.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: en daar sit niemand in nie
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The split 'daar ... in' is spoken style; written standard Afrikaans keeps 'daarin' together.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Splitting 'daar ... in' is ordinary written Afrikaans, not a fault, so the proposal is lateral.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'stuur vir die rover' is colloquial; 'stuur na' is the natural written form for sending over a distance.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'stuur vir die rover opdragte' is standard Afrikaans with the same recipient, so swapping the preposition is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Wiele en asse laat 'n rover rol
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: in plaas daarvan om te sleep
laat_vaar_vorige.na: in plaas daarvan dat dit sleep
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'om te sleep' suggests the vehicle drags something; 'dat dit sleep' makes the vehicle itself the one that drags.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: In 'om te sleep' the vehicle is clearly the one dragging, and the proposal has the same supposed ambiguity, so nothing improves.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: om hulle van naby te ondersoek
laat_vaar_vorige.na: om dit van naby te ondersoek
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'hulle' could point back to the Marsrovers; 'dit' refers clearly to the rocks and soil.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'hulle' reads naturally as the rocks and soil, while singular 'dit' could point to the arm or the tools, so the change adds an ambiguity.
